faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets is 100 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $1.90/pc (100 pcs starter tier), $1.15/pc (500 pcs tier), and $0.78/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets, and when is it waived?

Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets?
faqs.answer: Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets is custom-engineered from Die-Cast Zinc Alloy + Luminous Fill using Phosphorescent Afterglow & Metallic Glitter Enamel Fill, sized around 60×48×2.8mm at approximately 44g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Black Nickel / Gunmetal / Shiny Gold. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets?

Upgrade backing and presentation options—including higher-grade N52 rare-earth neodymium discs, full-surface anti-scratch soft rubber magnetic backing, clear EVA protective pads, or custom 400gsm Euro-slot retail display cards—can be specified in your quote.

faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets completes in 10–13 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Glow-in-the-Dark & Glitter Metal Fridge Magnets meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.
